Portions were declared unlawful and vacated nationwide on May 15, 2025 in Texas, et al. v. EEOC. The Commission then voted 2-1 on January 22, 2026 to rescind the guidance, announced January 23, 2026. Nothing was issued in its place. It is recorded here because the document it replaced points at it, and because a reader must not assume a current EEOC enforcement guidance on workplace harassment exists.
